newsitem.title: USA: Reader's Digest to buy back 5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Reader's Digest to buy back 5 mln shrs.

text.p: Reader's Digest Association Inc said Friday it plans to buy back five million shares of its Class A non-voting common stock, or about six percent of the Class A non-voting common outstanding.
The buys will take place in the open market from time to time as market conditions warrant, the company said.
Reader's Digest said it also has declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.45 per Class A and Class B non-voting share, payable November 1, record October 23.

Reader's Digest said the stock buyback program is the fifth such program since its initial public offering in 1990. Under the previous programs, it purchased about 16 million shares of Class A non-voting common.
It currently has about 85 million shares of Class A non-voting common and 22 million shares of Class B non-voting common outstanding.
